scope: Spec Kit 1.0.6 core lifecycle from Spike A; scores are engineering judgments, not benchmarks. Null means no defensible measurement yet.
scale: 0 worst, 10 best; low cost/lock-in score higher

userUtility.evidence: Install, multi-provider skills and actual feature-script survivor check; end-to-end quality deferred to B.

maturity.evidence: Real 1.0.5 to 1.0.6 upgrade, manifests and conservative modified-file handling; Windows wiring regression.

maintainability.evidence: Core assets and integration lifecycle delegated to upstream; no vendored implementation.

claudeCompatibility.evidence: Skills install; Linux lifecycle works; Windows foreign settings rewrite; live harness unverified.

codexCompatibility.evidence: Codex installs alongside Claude; native upgrade path retains registration, repeat force-init then Claude uninstall loses it. Live harness unverified.

reproducibility.evidence: Exact source commit, bundled assets and offline repeat; metadata differs and dependency closure is not hash-locked.

upgradeUninstall.evidence: Upgrade blocks edited skills; uninstall retains edits. Deletions restored, shared project infrastructure retained.

absenceOfFileConflicts.evidence: No natural Linux core overwrite; explicit force overwrites preexisting own-named skill; Windows settings LF/CRLF conflict.

teamwork.evidence: Task collaboration is outside lifecycle test; D pending.

boardIntegration.evidence: No board export executed in A; B/D pending.

security.evidence: Synthetic fixtures, source pin, conservative edited-file removal observed. No full upstream security audit.

offlineLocalFirst.evidence: Two successful installs with network namespace isolation after cache preparation.

integrationCost.evidence: Estimate 2–4 days for bounded composition; no workflow engine.

annualMaintenanceCost.evidence: Estimate 2–4 days/year for this integration only; not a measured annual budget.

lowVendorLockIn.evidence: MIT source, local Markdown artifacts, Claude and Codex integration paths tested.

licenseSuitability.evidence: MIT per official repository; no license incompatibility identified for this lab integration.
